notes.source: Olympedia final results; champion times cross-checked with Wikipedia event pages.
notes.resolution: Tenths of a second up to 1968, hundredths from 1972 (see `decimals`).
notes.finalists: Only finalists with a printed time are kept (DNS, DQ and untimed rows are dropped), so `n_finalists` counts finalists with a time.
notes.band: `band` is set only when all 8 finalists have a time; otherwise null.
notes.plot: Use `plot_year` for the x position (Tokyo 2020 is 2021). `chart_marker` in `absence_flags` says which absences the chart shows.
notes.scope: 28 individual pool events of the Paris 2024 programme, Olympic Games 1908-2024. Relays, 10 km marathon swimming, yard races and discontinued events are out.
notes.single_source: Silver, bronze and positions 4-8 come from Olympedia only.

absence_flags.reason: not invited after World War I

annotations.text: The final was re-swum after Norman Ross was disqualified on a protest. The time shown is the re-swim (1:01.4). The first final, with a faster 1:00.4 for the winner, is not the official result.
Olympedia lists the silver medallist 0.1 s faster than the gold medallist. The reason is not in this data; source it before any text mentions it.
First Games with a purpose-built 100 m pool. The race was a single length of the pool, with no turns. Earlier Olympic swimming was in open water.

Olympedia lists the 3rd-place time (2:43.9) slower than the 4th-place time (2:43.7). Wikipedia says the timekeepers had the 4th-place swimmer 0.2 s faster, while the judges ruled that the bronze medallist touched first (marked 'citation needed' on Wikipedia, so not confirmed).
Olympedia lists the 5th-place time (3:06.2) slower than the 6th-place time (3:06.1). The reason is not in this data; source it before any text mentions it.

Until 1956 the butterfly arm action was allowed in breaststroke races. Butterfly became its own event in 1956 and was banned from breaststroke, so the early 200 m breaststroke times (men 1908-1952, women 1924-1952) are not like-for-like with the later ones. The 1948 women's page says this; check its cited reference in the Words phase.
Same rule change as the men's 200 m breaststroke: butterfly became its own event in 1956 and was banned from breaststroke.
Swum on a 100 m course built in Stockholm harbour (open water), not in a pool.
The Tokyo 2020 Games were held in 2021.
